6064629376874512460.description: These boots remember every step taken along misted fen and ivy-covered causeway. Their soles hum faintly at dawn, when the veils between memory and magic are thinnest.

6064629688482136435.description: A raven to sell to the Abbot of the Pillars.

6064629722123927618.title: Tannin
6064629722123927618.description: A bitter-tasting chemical primarily found in plants.

6064629840785702966.title: Spore-Bearing Chunk
6064629840785702966.description: A chunk of sporebearing Mycelion flesh

6064630010935050245.title: Dawnbreaker
6064630010935050245.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of New Aela is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064630101221115329.title: Basic Chassis
6064630101221115329.description: Supports the structure and functionality of your caravan.

6064630140412756080.title: Journeyman Herbalist's Tool Belt
6064630140412756080.description: This belt holds more than pouches--it contains glyphs of preservation, designed to keep each harvest fresh as morning dew. It is an herbalist's entire world in microcosm--neatly organized, fiercely protected, and deeply alive.

6064630140778643589.title: Apprentice Leatherworker's Pants
6064630140778643589.description: Cut from soft-worn canvas and lined with supple suede, these pants are built for long hours hunched over hide and horn.

6064630140792602764.title: Novice Arcane Engineer's Shirt
6064630140792602764.description: Sleek lines reinforced with brass thread that seems to hum subtly near Essence-charged devices. The tiny, embroidered Z on each collar pays tribute to Zebris, Patron of Engineers and Alchemists.

6064630141144203417.title: Journeyman Cook's Tool Belt
6064630141144203417.description: Clean-lined and clever, this belt clinks with spoons and spirit. It cinches close to fire and flavor alike.

6064630141170024615.title: Apprentice Tanner's Skivvies
6064630141170024615.description: A rugged and unceremonious base layer, worn by those who work elbow-deep in alchemical brine, hide-stink, and the slow, sacred art of softening death into something useful.

6064630141171335336.title: Novice Tanner's Shirt
6064630141171335336.description: A thick, stink-bound garment built not for vanity, but for enduring the chemical fury of a craft that transforms hide into heritage. It stains, it scorches, and it sticks with you.

6064630141172252841.title: Journeyman Tanner's Tool Belt
6064630141172252841.description: This weathered, imminently practical belt is oddly sacred among those who know the smell of iron, salt, and turning flesh into something meant to last.

6064630169004015691.title: Stone Tablet
6064630169004015691.description: A large stone tablet made from an ancient tombstone.

6064630366708302012.title: Brooksteel Great Mace
6064630366708302012.description: The Brooksteel Great Mace moves with surprising grace, like driftwood caught in a strong current. Its blows land with a dull bloom of sound, felt more than heard.

6064631121001709581.title: Wyrmling
6064631121001709581.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631121090445365.title: Pridestrider
6064631121090445365.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Azmaran, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

6064631596330058792.title: Ring of the Drawn Hollow
6064631596330058792.description: In the heart of this burnished band, fire has been stilled, yet not silenced. Its magic waits patiently for a hand bold enough to wield it.

sources.name: A dead knight. He wears the armor of the Kaelar Army Tower Division. The body sustained numerous stab wounds. A military band on his wrist is engraved with the name, "Stonemarch."

6064631714157821954.description: Required to enchant gear, if enchanting is successful, gain 2 additional enchanting level. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721685417998.title: Apprentice Loss Prevention Enchanting Scroll
6064631721685417998.description: Required to enchant gear, prevents all negative impacts from enchanting. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631867835940866.description: The sliver of ancient splendor bound within this ring stirs with dormant energy, waiting to be rekindled by those who dare.

6064631868522299396.title: Sephillion Shard Scepter
6064631868522299396.description: Fitted concentric rings of polished crystal comprise the shaft of this heavy glass scepter. The rings are never still--rotating slowly, unpredictably, with gravitational force that doesn't belong to this realm.

6064631868548251654.title: Shatterwolf Pauldrons
6064631868548251654.description: Moonbitten iron, cold to the touch, marked with runes that only show under a predator's moon.

6064631868563718151.title: Mask of the Sighted
6064631868563718151.description: Snarling and silent, the mask's obsidian surface seems to drink the light. The eyes--sharp stones of jungle jade--never blink. Those who lock eyes with it forget, for a moment, how to breathe.

sources.name: Eudoxia agreed to sign my permit herself since I came through with the medical supplies.
Harold said he'd sign my permit if I completed a commission from his board. I should return to him when I've done one.
Markus Hernet is looking for eager artisans. He's agreed to sign my paperwork if I agree to take up a trade.
There's a false door behind the ruined temple with stairs leading down. I'll likey find Petrah's contacts within.

sources.name: I've arrived at the camp and encountered Altharok Bloodspeaker, who is hostile towards me. While I'm unsure if he has the Horn of the Great Herd, the tracks lead here, and it's likely he's guarding it. I must defeat him and keep an eye out for signs of Zinjala's involvement.

6064632700245578595.description: A rare toxic mushroom with a pale skull-like cap and black gills. It grows on rotting undead, fed by lingering spiritual energy. Its poison causes rapid decay, and even a touch brings slow, agonizing death.

6064632700248068965.title: Solvanna Root
6064632700248068965.description: A gnarled root with cracked beige skin and lighter interior. It grows with daffodils, enriching the soil. When brewed, it creates a tea with powerful psychedelic effects.

6064632717779992578.title: Slagbreaker's Mining Tool Belt
6064632717779992578.description: Not all who worked in Braithreach were skilled artisans. Aelan slaves toiled endlessly to break open slag to recover bits of usable ore in the sweltering heat.

6064632733922426884.description: The smiths of Braithreach wore garb emblazoned with insignias of home. They became grim reminders of who their blades would cut down.

6064633289012281371.title: Chipped Lodestone
6064633289012281371.description:
Drop: Tidewarden 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: A dull fragment of blackened metal, unyielding to time and the corrosive touch of the sea. It seems attracted to iron, and dust.

6064633289012740128.title: Bellsong's Long-Lasting Lubricant
6064633289012740128.description:
Drop: The Lamplighter 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: Lubricating oil is a necessity when it comes to intricate smithing and complex devices. None is greater nor has as much longevity as Bellson's Long-Lasting Lubricant.

6064633289013133346.title: Lead Sap
6064633289013133346.description: A pouch of lead fishing weights, bundled together as if to sap a glove.

6064633289756246386.title: Crushbone Hammer
6064633289756246386.description: Few sea giants have intellect beyond savage, but some have wisdom greater than a sea captain. Crushbone is a wise one, but a wise one that carries a bone-crushing war hammer.

6064633289807561130.title: Dun'mor Helm
6064633289807561130.description: The legendary sea smithies of Dun'Mor crafted the finest armor. Their shiny helms were a testament of exquisite craftsmanship and artistry.

6064633289863856625.title: Settler Militia Forearms
6064633289863856625.description: Refurbished plate armor bracer an imprinted with the Settler Militia insignia. In the Kaelar Empire, everyone is soldier when called upon.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064633289867198984.title: Marching Boots
6064633289867198984.description: Intended for patrols and prolonged campaigns, these leather bound boots provide comfort and protection for every soldier.

6064633290456891394.title: Crate of Crimson Palm Oil
6064633290456891394.description:
The oil is known for its rich, deep red color and is highly coveted for its use as a moisturizer among the wealthy.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Case of Gold Stained Orchid Petals

A rare and delicate petals from an orchid that blooms only once every few decades in the deepest, most protected areas of the tropical jungle. Stained with gold dye and displayed as an extravagant show of wealth.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Bone Ornements

Exquisitely crafted ivory ornaments, hand carved by Vek shaman and traditionally used in rituals and are highly sought after by aristocrats to decorate their homes.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Moon Fruit Cakes

A crate of cakes made with a rare, glowing fruit that only grows on trees near the coasts of tropical islands. It is highly valued for its sweet taste and decadent glow under a full moon.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Celestial Pearls

These pearls have a faint, otherworldly glow and are prized for their beauty and rarity. The pearls are considered a symbol of status.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Molten Crystal
A crystal emitting a smoldering heat. The closer you get to the entrance of the Befallen Forge, the hotter it becomes.

6064633293452017723.title: Springmetal Strip
6064633293452017723.description:
Drop: Sharpclaw Talrith 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A thin strip of highly flexible metal that always returns to its original shape. Makes for excellent lockpicks, or the stiff back of a thin dagger.

more: Pure blood of the bSilken cords of sinewy strands, tightly twisted and darkly stained. Coarse yet strong, it could be used to sew a wound, or string a puppet, or bind a book. It bears a faint, metallic scent.east! Could be used for alchemy.

6064633300745912360.title: Arlogian Collar
6064633300745912360.description: When the moons align just right, the spirits of the Arlogian Wolves are rumored to howl within the fields surrounding Winstead. Only the blur of their spectral forms can be seen as they race with arcane speed.

6064633328325492739.title: Joshua Tree Timber

6064633334138339331.title: Alligator
6064633334138339331.description:
Ground Mount
Level 23

165% Ground Speed
115% Water Speed
more: Tamed not by fear, but by relentless discipline and ancient methods known only to the bravest beastmasters, the Giant Alligator mount is a marvel of both might and obedience. Thirty feet of armored muscle and bone, it moves with uncanny precision for a creature of its size, bearing saddle and rider across wetlands, rivers, and flooded ruins with effortless command of the deep. Its breath is slow and measured, its gaze watchful and cold, and beneath the surface, it can vanish with the silence of a ghost. Though it holds the power to crush stone and uproot trees, this colossus bends its will to those who earn its respect. Swift through water, imposing on land, the Giant Alligator mount is a rare prize and a symbol of mastery over the primal forces that lurk beneath still waters.

6064633334476701728.title: Banana Seed
6064633334476701728.description:
Purchase: Agriculatural Supply: Farming Supply 
Ingredient In: Farming
more: Banana seed can be used to grow more bananas.

6064633334491054114.title: Dragon Tree Seed
6064633334491054114.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea 
Ingredient In: Farming
more: Dragon Tree seed can be used to grow more dragon trees.

6064633338879213758.title: Coconut Caravan Wheels
6064633338879213758.description: A customized wheel for your caravan.

6064633380032544807.title: Sea Debris
6064633380032544807.description: Splintered and broken bits of junk with no clear purpose or form that could be repurposed for crafting or building. It's little more than a forgotten fragment of the sea, offering no practical value.

6064633391251980295.title: Giant Beetle
6064633391251980295.description:
Ground Mount

155% Ground Speed
150% Maximum Health

6064633391253880840.title: Giant Beetle Beast Of Burden
6064633391253880840.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064633391298773005.title: Coin of Betrayer's Gold
6064633391298773005.description: Gilded in false promise? this coin is shiny, but cold. It carries the weight of unkept vows, and it's found too often in the backs of fallen allies.

6064633408276529156.title: Journeyman Ashen Sifts
6064633408276529156.description: A fine glimmering powder, oddly cool to the touch. As it is stirred or poured sparks of active essence flicker and flare within.

6064633419123392527.title: Joshua Tree Seed
6064633419123392527.description:
Gather: Sandsquall Desert 
Ingredient In: Farming

6064633419686019081.title: Journeyman Tempering Kit - Accessory
6064633419686019081.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633429445246999.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Mythbreak
6064633429445246999.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Mythbreak.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Mythbreak to place this banner.

6064633430592259223.title: Warden Splinter
6064633430592259223.description:
Drop: The Lore Warden 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: This splinter is no dead scrap of wood, it is alive, a tenacious offshoot of something wild. Its rough, splintered surface writhes in your hand, each tiny point a source of constant irritation.

6064633447777697832.title: Hammer of Kuu'Shuu
6064633447777697832.description: Through great arcane effort the ancient Torens summoned the Flame Elemental, Kuu-Shuu. They bound him and forced him to toil away in a fire forge only he and his ilk could tolerate. There he would hammer upon a great anvil to produce superior arms for Toren warlords.

6064633447856079151.title: The Mirror Helm
6064633447856079151.description: The Mirror Helm was crafted by the mages of the Eternal Circle. Made expressly for King Atrax, the helm would create a spectral image of the ruler of the Toren Empire. As long as King Atrax was in some form of existence, his spectral form would act as a phantasmal guardian wherever it was bound.

6064633452964347907.title: Striped Barrelfish
6064633452964347907.description:

6064633453035782494.title: Horticulturalist Gloves
6064633453035782494.description: Horticulturists from the arcane halls of Carphin had numerous horticultural expeditions into the Jundark. Searching for life-giving serums, yet guarded against toxic intrusions, most of these expeditions were lost to the tangles.

6064633453062980031.title: Recipe: Blood Hoop
6064633453062980031.description: Journeyman Jeweler recipe for Blood Hoop.

6064633453091750340.title: Sunscale Scallop
6064633453091750340.description:
Drop: Barnacle Brenn 
Ingredient In: Tailoring
more: Kaelar sea captains, prizing the Sunscale Scallop's beauty and rarity, proudly wore its iridescent shells as badges on their tricorne hats. Each shell, unique in its colorful shimmer, signified a captain's experience and the tales of their daring voyages in the Jundark's perilous shallows.

6064633453640417742.title: Recipe: Stonehide Scale
6064633453640417742.description: Journeyman Arcane Engineering recipe for creating a Stonehide Scale

6064633453665124401.title: Cacao Pod
6064633453665124401.description: A ripe fruit from the cacao tree, filled with sweet pulp and bitter seeds. Houses cacao beans the first step on the journey to chocolate.

6064633492642857095.title: Siege Antidote
6064633492642857095.description: Use this antidote on a poisoned well to cure it.

6064633584000499718.title: Siege Explosive Charge
6064633584000499718.description: Use this charge to damage the barracks, increasing the respawn time for the defending settlement.

6064633730621702235.title: Discarded Pack
6064633730621702235.description: A settler pack seemingly discarded in haste.

6064633764297965568.title: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies
6064633764297965568.description: A bag of fun things to select as a reward

6064633804759695365.title: Foetid Mucus
6064633804759695365.description: noxious clot description (Inspect this for QUEST)

6064633860905959426.title: Stonechant Treads
6064633860905959426.description: Muffled steps that seem to echo twice, once for the wearer, once for the stone.

6064633860905959430.title: Stonechant Grips
6064633860905959430.description: Fingers drum without rhythm while worn, though none recall doing so.

6064633860908187681.title: Tithebrook Grips
6064633860908187681.description: Palms remain dry in rain, but not when handling owed things.

6064633860908646437.title: Hallowmark Vestment
6064633860908646437.description: Those who wore it once carried no blades, only the burden of witnessing.

6064633860909367345.title: Suncleft Choir Bracers
6064633860909367345.description: Etched with subtle sigils too faint to catch the eye, these bracers hum when struck by daylight, as if remembering the cadence of rites once carried out in vaults no longer marked on any map.

6064633860909367347.title: Suncleft Choir Gloves
6064633860909367347.description: The seams of these gloves hold firm against heat and time, their fit favored by those who practice crafts that require both precision and devotion beneath the watch of ancestral shrines.

6064633860910350393.title: Starlight Creed Leggings
6064633860910350393.description: Tapered to the line of wind-slick sails, these leggings hold the memory of distant voyages. Each step lands with the hush of sea-foam on midnight stone.

6064633860915921041.title: Cindermarch Jerkin
6064633860915921041.description: Fitted for both protection and pace, its layered panels flex with the body whether striding over stone passes or facing a braced line of steel.

6064633860916248730.title: Brinetread Jerkin
6064633860916248730.description: Balanced for both defense and ease of movement, its panels shift with the body whether bracing on deck or moving through shallows.

6064633860916248732.title: Brinetread Leggings
6064633860916248732.description: Cut for long strides across deck or shoreline, they give as easily to a leap as to a crouch.

6064633860916773028.title: Gritmantle Boots
6064633860916773028.description: Tread with the certainty of a guard walking the ramparts, gripping loose sand and hard rock alike without falter.

6064633860918411454.title: Slagwalker Cuirass
6064633860918411454.description: Layered plates shaped to bear both the weight of iron dust and the blows of battle, its dull sheen recalling the glow of cooled slag.

6064633860918739148.title: Wavebound Gloves
6064633860918739148.description: Supple enough to knot rope or draw steel, the fingers are reinforced against the constant bite of salt and wind.

6064633860920901876.title: Tidepiercer Cuisass
6064633860920901876.description: Broad-paneled and contoured to the frame, its surface pitted faintly as if shaped from metal drawn from the sea floor.

6064633860920901881.title: Tidepiercer Gloves
6064633860920901881.description: Fingers capped and jointed for sure hold on rope and oar, the knuckles marked with the faint green of sea patina.

6064633860921229565.title: Scorchmantle Cuirass
6064633860921229565.description: Plated in sun-burnished layers, the surface carries a muted shimmer like heat haze on distant stone, built for those who endure the desert's longest marches.

6064633860921229571.title: Scorchmantle Belt
6064633860921229571.description: Cinches the armor with layered straps, the central buckle etched with the curling pattern of desert winds.

6064633860921491721.title: Duskhunter Bracers
6064633860921491721.description: Fit firm at the forearms, giving the strength to block without stealing the quickness from the arms.

6064633860921491723.title: Duskhunter Gloves
6064633860921491723.description: Grip with the unshakable control of a tracker on the final approach, steady despite the weight of humidity and silence.

6064633860947050785.title: Deepward Bastion Cuirass
6064633860947050785.description: Forged beneath the cracked vaults of the Anvils, this breastplate still carries soot from the forges that refused to go cold. It was made for those who stand when the mountain groans.

6064633860948164915.title: Undermarch Wardplate
6064633860948164915.description: Etched with lines that follow no known language, this chestguard is layered in the fashion of sealed gates and old pacts. The plates clink like locks checking themselves.

6064633860948164922.title: Undermarch Girding Chain
6064633860948164922.description: More iron than leather, this belt once secured keys and tablets to a watcher's hip. The chain never rattles unless truth is questioned nearby.

6064633860948820289.title: Verdant Yoke Greaves
6064633860948820289.description: Plated in ridged fernmetal, these greaves flex with root-bound strength. Those who wear them learn to move with the earth, not over it..

6064633860949147980.title: Crownbreaker Girdle
6064633860949147980.description: Woven from scavenged mail and riveted leather, this belt binds more than armor. It holds together the frayed edges of purpose, and hums when worn by one whose loyalty cannot be bought.

6064633860950917458.title: Luminous Concord Burbute
6064633860950917458.description: A style of helmet first cast in the veiled forges of Moltruin, this helm carries a hush that lingers behind the eyes. Thought narrows, and distractions fall away like sparks in wind.

6064633860983357859.title: Moltruin Helm
6064633860983357859.description: Crowns the head with the stillness of a peak before eruption, the gaze beneath as unwavering as basalt cliffs.

6064633860983947699.title: Sunbastion Bracers
6064633860983947699.description: Hold the forearms with the strength of a gate bar slid into place, ready to meet the impact of a weapon or the shove of a shield wall.

6064633860984275389.title: Graveplate Gauntlets
6064633860984275389.description: Hold firm as the roots that split stone, each strike backed by the unrelenting force of the deep earth.

6064633860985061827.title: Ironwake Cuirass
6064633860985061827.description: Holds the chest in the same unyielding frame as the mountain gates, each plate formed to turn aside the heaviest of strikes.

6064633860985061833.title: Ironwake Pauldrons
6064633860985061833.description: Rest upon the shoulders as the keystones rest upon the arch, balancing strength with perfect placement.

6064633860987486711.title: Anvilguard Girdle
6064633860987486711.description: Holds the armor close with the same binding force that joins stone to stone in the walls of a citadel.

6064633860987945472.title: Reefguard Tassets
6064633860987945472.description: Guard the upper legs with plates shaped to turn aside the swift strikes of the shallows, layered like the living walls that shelter the life within.

6064633860997710362.title: Emberwake Grips
6064633860997710362.description: The fingertips stain red after prolonged wear, though no wound can be found.

6064633860998300193.title: Thistlemaw Treads
6064633860998300193.description: Carries a clinging hush that deepens the longer the wearer stands still.

6064633860999086638.title: Ashwoke Hood
6064633860999086638.description: This cowl holds the hush of kilns long gone cold. Beneath its folds, even bright voices falter.

6064633860999086644.title: Ashwoke Cuffs
6064633860999086644.description: Bands etched with curling scorch lines, said to tighten when the air grows dry and still.

6064633861004132931.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Girdle
6064633861004132931.description: Fitted where form meets foundation, this girdle bears layered traces of forgotten geometry. Those who wear it speak of sudden stillness when standing at the meeting of thresholds.

6064633861004132933.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Boots
6064633861004132933.description: Treaders of ash and ember, these boots whisper with every step, as if remembering the echo of chants once spoken in chambers beneath the Anvils. Their soles hold warmth not from forge, but from faith sealed into stone.

6064633861004657229.title: Unfallen Rainment Tunic
6064633861004657229.description: Threaded with hues that shift like reeflight through shallow waves, this tunic carries the silence of wrecked cathedrals and the breath of sunken oaths. Its weave seems to resist stillness, always leaning toward the current.

6064633861005247060.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Spaulders
6064633861005247060.description: Fashioned in imitation of relics uncovered from collapsed shrines, these spaulders carry a silence that deepens with distance from the oasis winds. Their shape suggests memory given form, rather than protection alone.

6064633861010752178.title: Shadeweft Bracers
6064633861010752178.description: Rest snug on the forearms, giving just enough guard to turn a sudden strike while keeping the arms light for quick motion.

6064633861012062909.title: Thistledown Cape
6064633861012062909.description: Lifts and falls with each step like seed carried on the wind, its edges trailing in patterns as light as drifting pollen.

6064633861012259520.title: Glimmersoot Shoulders
6064633861012259520.description: Lie close against the frame, turning aside the errant spark or glancing blow without catching on narrow passage walls.

6064633861012718290.title: Veilsand Shoulders
6064633861012718290.description: Lie smooth against the frame, shedding stray grains so no weight builds where it does not belong.

6064633861014553348.title: Duneflare Gloves
6064633861014553348.description: Fit with the precision of a bowstring pull, steady enough for the fine grip needed in a sandstorm's blur.

6064633861014881030.title: Nightwhisper Hood
6064633861014881030.description: Draws low to break the shape of the head against the tangle of shadow and vine, leaving the gaze clear for the smallest movement.

6064633861406785538.title: Rusty Great Mace
6064633861406785538.description: Metal twisted and welded together to make a shape of a twisted sun.  With the heft of this mighty weapon none shall impede your progress.

6064633865832693761.title: Indestructible Copper Dagger
6064633865832693761.description: A basic but enduring blade, often the first weapon a fledgling spellcaster or thief calls their own. It gleams faintly with age, not arrogance--a quiet companion in close, dangerous moments.

6064633866775101465.title: Cindertouched Necklace
6064633866775101465.description: Formed from fire-scored iron and cooled in silence beneath the ruin of Moltruin, this pendant is said to deflect unseen judgments. When worn, it carries the weight of battles survived but unspoken.

6064633866903945296.title: Ironhearth Hand Axe
6064633866903945296.description: Forged in the emberbanks of old Duunhold and quenched in stone-fed cisterns, the Ironhearth Hand Axe carries the breath of the mountain in its weight. Its edge bears faint striations like frozen flame, and when swung near bare rock, the haft grows warm as if stirred by memory. It is not a tool of haste but of resolve.

6064633867126767810.title: Mirageborn Twin Daggers
6064633867126767810.description: Contours seem to waver at a glance and then true, like dune lines under a shifting wind.

6064633867180048605.title: Stormcurrent Focus
6064633867180048605.description: Cool to the touch, its frame shaped to channel the pull of flowing water.

6064633867186536686.title: Sunscorch Longbow
6064633867186536686.description: Pale gold tones flicker across the smooth frame in open light.

6064633867203641610.title: Mirageborn Mace
6064633867203641610.description: Contours blur in the heat's shimmer before returning to a sure, deliberate shape.

6064633867225202998.title: Mistwood Rapier
6064633867225202998.description: Thin as a whisper and twice as quick, the Mistwood Rapier barely stirs the air it passes through. It vanishes easily in shadow and never rusts, even when left in rain.

6064633867225334071.title: Stoneforge Rapier
6064633867225334071.description: The Stoneforge Rapier moves with deliberate grace, as if carved from purpose rather than forged from ore. It rings once when drawn, then holds its breath until blood is spilled.

6064633867226841404.title: Coralblade Rapier
6064633867226841404.description: Balanced for motion as much as edge, this rapier carries the flowing grace of coastal winds. Its surface glistens faintly, like scales glimpsed beneath breaking waves.

6064633867241718116.title: Seabright Scepter
6064633867241718116.description: Salt-clear gleam along smooth curves, the whole shaped to move like water around stone.

6064633867264328100.title: Sandcarved Spear
6064633867264328100.description: Etched with wind-scoured patterns, its shaft sings with the hush of dust storms crossing forgotten paths.

6064633867267342766.title: Shadowfang Spear
6064633867267342766.description: Its point is keen and unyielding, like the silent predators of the Jundark night.

6064633867280908759.title: Stormcurrent Sword
6064633867280908759.description: Forged where river meets sky, its edge sings in the language of rising tempests. A faint brine clings to the steel, as though the sea still claims it.

6064633867289035249.title: Dreadwake Greatsword
6064633867289035249.description: Cold spray seems to cling to its edge, and the scent of salt haunts its draw. It moves with the certainty of a closing tide.

6064633895661994016.title: Cosmetic: Pseudo Dragon
6064633895661994016.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895674904615.title: Mount Cosmetic: Swift Claw
6064633895674904615.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Lean as a whip and quick as thought, the Swift Claw is a predator?s dream made mount. With claws that grip like hooks and reflexes honed for the hunt, it streaks across battlefield and brush alike. Only those who can match its pace earn the privilege of its saddle.

6064633895681458218.title: Cosmetic: Wrath's Harbinger
6064633895681458218.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895706492985.title: Cosmetic: Guardian Nimbus
6064633895706492985.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895722876996.title: Mount Cosmetic: Ebon Omen
6064633895722876996.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Wreathed in black mist and cloaked in legend, the Ebon Omen is a harbinger of ruin said to emerge when disaster looms. Its eyes glow with an unnatural light, and its silent steps chill the air around it. Some believe it to be a cursed remnant from the fall of ancient Verra, others claim it is drawn to those marked by fate. Whether omen or omen-bringer, its presence never goes unnoticed, and its riders are often met with wary glances and hushed prayers.

6064633895740637262.title: Cosmetic: Oak Stoat
6064633895740637262.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895804207216.title: Cosmetic: Ghastly Ghuul
6064633895804207216.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895841431689.title: Mount Cosmetic: Cloudburst Pegasus
6064633895841431689.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Wreathed in mist and lightning, the Cloudburst Pegasus rides the upper winds of Verra?s northern peaks. With hooves that strike thunder and a mane of rolling cloud, it slips through the storm with uncanny ease. Coveted by traders, scouts, and thrill seekers alike, this elusive creature remains fiercely untamed. To ride one is to earn its respect and trust, for nothing less will do.

6064633897239511106.description:

6064633900522274841.title: Stoneforge Emberbite
6064633900522274841.description: Born in a kiln sealed with rune-bricks and fed on ember coals, the Stoneforge Emberbite leaves a faint scorch where it rests. The edge glows only when buried deep, and the haft smells faintly of charred cedar. Some claim it remembers every cut it has ever made.

6064633900553470004.title: Runeweld Spellhew
6064633900553470004.description: Etched with binding script and cooled with tinctured oil, the Runeweld Spellhew hums with unread intent. Sparks crawl between the runes when struck against old stone, and once drawn, it seems reluctant to rest.

6064633900554190903.title: Seabright Tideshaper Great Axe
6064633900554190903.description: A pale marine gleam collects along the edge, brightening when the blade moves as if crossing sunlit water.

6064633900556484669.title: Sunscorch Sunwrought Great Axe
6064633900556484669.description: The air around the edge wavers at motion, a dry shimmer that leaves only the line of the cut.

6064633900556746814.title: Thornbound Briar Great Axe
6064633900556746814.description: Veined with patterns unseen to most eyes, this weapon bends slightly when held, as if remembering the curve of something once coiled and living.

6064633900611338310.title: Brooksteel Riversting
6064633900611338310.description: The Brooksteel Riversting glides with the ease of current over stone and hums faintly before a strike. When drawn near water, reflections shift slightly, as if anticipating the blade.

6064633900651380849.title: Ironhearth Tremorhead
6064633900651380849.description: The Ironhearth Tremorhead sends a faint vibration through the ground with each swing, felt more than heard. Walls struck by it have been known to groan hours later.

6064633900651708530.description: Grain along the metal reads like wind carved layers on a dune face.

Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Squall's End holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064634325302509570.title: Pridestrider
6064634325302509570.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Miraleth, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

6064634614489022464.title: Adventurer's Chest
more: A chest to start you on your first steps into adventure!

6064634618875936822.title: Tailor's Pants
6064634618875936822.description: Finely stitched pants worn by those who serve the seam between utility and artistry. Often unnoticed beneath the folds of a tunic, leggings hold the first tension of thread and form for a new apprentice.

6064634618877313079.title: Tailor's Shirt
6064634618877313079.description: A garment that teaches its wearer through fit, fiber, and the subtle structure of stitching. Every visible seam is done in the most rudimentary stitch style--a visible reminder of how little you know at the start. If it embarrasses you, good. That's the whole point.

6064634618893828158.title: Lumberjack's Pants
6064634618893828158.description: Stiff-legged trousers waxed with pine sap to repel water, insects, and weak resolve. They smell of timber and toil, and they only soften after your first season of honest work.

6064634618947043412.title: Animal Husbandrist's Skivvies
6064634618947043412.description: Stained by sun and soil, these rugged trousers know the rhythm of hoof and breath. Reinforced knees and deep pockets anticipate care, struggle, and renewal.

6064634619337572457.title: Hunting Bow
6064634619337572457.description: Smoothed with ash resin and strung with hemp fiber. Not quite graceful, not yet deadly--but certainly hungry.

6064634654088298625.title: Wandering Star Vestment
6064634654088298625.description: This chestpiece seem to be covered with a fine dust.. or maybe magical residue from its travel through the portal...

6064634654088298627.title: Wandering Star Trousers
6064634654088298627.description: Travel across the lands through portals beyond.

6064634654088298633.title: Wanderguard Cape
6064634654088298633.description: A cape that flows like the winds of the worlds, that sparkle like the stars of the skies.

6064634654088298644.title: Wanderer's Longbow
6064634654088298644.description: Where ever you may wander, may this weapon guide you true.

6064634654088364182.title: Wanderer's Scepter
6064634654088364182.description: Where ever you may wander, may this weapon guide you true.

6064634674831687692.title: Insignia of Endless Flame
6064634674831687692.description: Issued by the Sufire Constortium.  A bronze-plated medallion depicting a burning sun, suspended from a silken bracelet of pale gold - a reminder that illumination is never free: the flame consumes as it reveals.

6064634715576336410.title: Master Artisan Commodity Crate
more: Blood Stained Parchment
This tattered parchment is stained with blood and is emblazoned with a lidless eye.

6064634716620134253.title: 29 (Medium Physical) Bloodrunner - Rare
6064634716620134253.description: Grants a set of gear and weapons.

6064634744462508046.title: Requisition Slip
6064634744462508046.description: An order for tavern supplies issued by Trade Minister Duane of Aven's End.

6064634744584208707.title: Crude Mining Pickaxe
6064634744584208707.description: It sings a dull tone when swung with confidence and a flat one when hesitated--more tutor than tool. The rhythm of the mine begins here.

6064634756306108659.title: Nexus Regulator Water Sample
6064634756306108659.description: Murky water taken from the Nexus Regulator.

6064634762018029649.title: Bull's Cutting Board
6064634762018029649.description: This butcher?s block shield, heavy with grim camp tradition, bears cleaving sigils meant to swallow the first blow and free the answer. It protects without mercy or ceremony, like a chopping board that learned to refuse the knife.

6064634767640363117.title: Warden's Lantern-Lens
6064634767640363117.description:
Drop: Gorgum Kilnaxe 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: From the collapsed tomb's guardlight. Its lens once lit oath duels under moonrise.

6064634767641935989.title: Shrinecleft Haft
6064634767641935989.description:
Drop: Tharne the Crossways Butcher 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: Butcher?s haft split and repaired with shrinewood. Finger-grooves worn down by one hand.

6064634767643312251.title: Drainweft Filament
6064634767643312251.description:
Drop: Gilded Drain Brood Colossus 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: A loop of webline taken from the Gilded Drain ceiling. Vibrates faintly when held near moving water.

6064634772515979302.title: Novice Fishing Pole
6064634772515979302.description: Sanded smooth and strung tight, this pole flexes like a promise. You'll remember every cast.

6064634772519321641.title: Novice Lumberjacking Axe
6064634772519321641.description: Chopping adolescent trees causes more durability loss.
more: The head is forged from iron kissed with charcoal ash, and the haft is sanded smooth by a hundred nervous palms. It swings straighter than it should. That's how you know it's yours.
